articles.note: $5,000 student wage exemption, no year limit. Pakistan treaty is one of the oldest US treaties (1957/59).
Pakistan scholarships exempt only when paid from foreign source.

notes: AUDIT 2025-05-19: Verified Article XIII(1) against IRS Pub 901 Tables 2 & 3 (Pakistan) and US-Pakistan Income Tax Convention (signed 1957-07-01, entered into force 1959-07-01). Pakistan's $5,000 student wage exemption is unusual for having NO year cap — the benefit is available for the entire duration of student status. The same article id covers both student wages (US-source) and scholarships (foreign-source).
